attr.title: OpenLF2
attr.desc: An open-source engine for Little Fighter 2. It plays the original game from LF2_v2.0a.exe, which the game offers to download or you copy in yourself.
attr.inst: Start the port once; if the device is online it offers to download LF2_v2.0a.exe. Otherwise copy LF2_v2.0a.exe into ports/openlf2/conf/. Quit with Hotkey + Start.
